main_body: Small wooden slop bucket: a brown rim with a green slop patch inside, a blue-grey band, then a brown staved body with a dark outline.
top_band: Rows 6-7 hold a thin orange-brown rim (L130) over a dark olive line (L64). Row 8 is brown, and a green-grey patch sits at rows 8-9. Together this is a 1-2 row rim, not a surface band. The blue-grey (#363e47) interior at x=10 rows 9-12 is a darker vertical stripe, not a lighter top surface.
evidence: The column scan shows only a 1-row light rim (row 6) and a dark line (row 7) above the body at rows 8-12, which stays in one brown family. The bucket reads as a front-on elevation with a thin rim. There is no elliptical opening and no visible interior surface; the slop is a small green patch and a dark vertical drip painted on the front. This matches the red 'rim only / thin barrel lid' case in the guide, not the green barrel with an ellipse top. The inside of the opening is not seen from above.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 9 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and under one full tile in size. It has about 3 shading steps on the wood against 5-6 in Beodeul. The outline is tinted dark brown (0% neutral dark edge pixels), so it is not a near-black sticker line. The surfaces are small and simple with almost no grain or per-stave texture, so it looks thinner and flatter than the references.
